why: The first figure is turned 90 degrees anticlockwise: the arrow pointing up now points left. Turn the third figure the same way: the black ends go left and right, and the T lies on its side with its top bar on the left. Option 3 fits. Option 1 has the bar on the right, which is a clockwise turn.
trick: After a turn, check the small sign inside; its bar must move the same way as the arrow.
